title: unify-sdk-auth-retries-and-streaming-parity-python-ts-go
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs had divergent auth refresh logic, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming ergonomics which caused uneven developer experience and subtle production bugs. This PR unifies token refresh + auth hooks, standardizes retry/backoff behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, and brings streaming API parity and ergonomics improvements (async iterators/context managers in Python, readable stream helpers in TS, and iterator helpers in Go). Summary of changes: 1) Introduce centralized AuthProvider interface and token refresh flow used by all SDK clients. 2) Replace ad-hoc retry wrappers with a shared RetryPolicy (exponential with jitter, configurable caps) and surface consistent defaults. 3) Streaming: Python gains async iterator + contextmanager for stream lifecycle, TS adds ReadableStream wrapper and onData/onError ergonomic helpers, Go adds StreamIterator helper with context cancellation. 4) Bump package versions: python 0.9.8 -> 0.10.0, typescript 0.9.6 -> 0.10.0, go v0.9.5 -> v0.10.0. 5) Tests and docs updated, small migration guide added. Checklist: [x] design doc (linked) [x] linear tasks connected ENG-2187/ENG-2190 [x] unit/integration tests added/updated [x] changelogs and migration notes [x] version bumps and package manifests updated Migration notes: For most users this is non-breaking; token refresh hooks are opt-in via the AuthProvider shim for custom auth, but default behavior remains backward compatible. Consumers using custom retry parameters should review RetryPolicy defaults and opt into new config if they need previous behavior. Related: Linear ENG-2187, ENG-2190, PM-134. See docs/sdk/migration/auth-retries.md for example updates.
